summary.text: Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details. Check messages, links and official CPF contact details before responding.

details.heading: Official WhatsApp account
details.body: The official WhatsApp sender is “CPF Board Text Us” with the blue badge. Its phone number is 6031 5753.

details.heading: When you are unsure
details.body: Check with the ScamShield app or call the 24/7 ScamShield anti-scam helpline via 1799.

steps.name: Protect your log-ins
steps.text: Do not share your Singpass or bank log-in details with anyone. CPF officers will never ask for them.

steps.name: Check the sender
steps.text: Check that messages come through CPF's official channels. Calls use 6227 1188, SMSes use the “gov.sg” sender ID, and emails end with @cpf.gov.sg or @e.cpf.gov.sg.

steps.name: Check links
steps.text: Examine links before clicking. Check that the link domain ends with “.gov.sg”. On a computer, hover over the link. On a mobile device, hold your finger down on it to see the full address.

steps.name: Report suspicious messages
steps.text: Report suspicious messages pretending to come from CPF Board through the CPF official hotline or Write to us. If unsure, check with the ScamShield app or call 1799.
